title: PHP2Shell: two unauthenticated PHP core RCEs exploited in the wild, still not in CISA KEV
why: Exploitation observed in the wild by watchTowr honeypots and Cloudflare (early attacks) and a PoC is public; watchTowr's FAQ still lists CISA KEV as 'Not listed' when re-checked ~19:55Z Oct 21. Missing on Microsoft's side: no KEV entry (non-Microsoft product, so MSRC n/a).
action: Upgrade PHP to 8.5.12/8.4.27/8.3.36/8.2.35 (or distro backports) and restart all workers; until then apply PHP's memory_limit/session.upload_progress mitigations and capture memory evidence on suspected hosts before restarting.

title: FortiSIEM unauthenticated gRPC path traversal to RCE: public PoC, still not in CISA KEV
why: Working unauthenticated RCE exploit published by Horizon3 (github horizon3ai/CVE-2026-106173); Fortinet says not known exploited and it is not in CISA KEV. Missing on Microsoft's side: no KEV entry.
action: Upgrade FortiSIEM per FG-IR-26-180 (e.g. 7.5.0 -> 7.5.1+), block tcp/27918 from untrusted networks, and check timestamps of /opt/charting/redishb.sh and /opt/phoenix/bin/phLicenseTool.

title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain compromise: stolen cloud credentials abused; initial access via stolen GitHub CLI OAuth tokens
why: Malicious 1.107.0 wheels and Docker tags shipped a credential stealer and RAT loader; Wiz observed stolen AWS credentials being validated by the attacker 16:20-17:01Z Oct 21. No CVE and no KEV entry exists for this supply-chain compromise.
action: Find every host/CI runner/container that ran litellm 1.107.0 or a floating tag pulled Oct 21, rebuild from litellm==1.106.2 pinned by digest, and rotate every secret those hosts could read (start with LiteLLM proxy provider keys and cloud role creds).

title: GitLab CE/EE unauthenticated RCE via regex compiler integer overflow (CVSS 10), affects versions back to 7.0
why: GitLab's Oct 21 critical patch release discloses an unauthenticated RCE (CVSS 10.0) and ships detections for exploitation attempts; covered by The Hacker News and Hacker News chatter. No PoC or in-the-wild use seen yet; not in CISA KEV.
action: Upgrade every self-managed GitLab instance (including staging/DR) to 19.5.1/19.4.3/19.3.6/19.2.9/19.1.9/19.0.10/18.11.13 and deploy GitLab's 'Onigmo native worker crash' and 'Org mode render error burst' detections.
